about: Synthetic corpus authored by the team against the fictional Fernlight seed guidelines (battery fact: 'A full charge lasts up to 12 hours at medium brightness', warranty exactly 2 years, recycled content exactly 100%). Labels were written from what a careful human would conclude, before looking at output. 'expect' lists every non-supported finding as RULE:status ('needs_review' = cannot tell, 'contradicted' = disagrees with the approved fact, 'unverified' = no approved fact found); 'supported' lists the rules that may be reported as supported; 'replacements' lists the automatic replacement texts the FACT rules may offer (everything else must be advice). 'knownLimit' cases record wording the rules do NOT handle: the label says what a person would expect, and the case is reported separately and left out of precision/recall. This is a regression baseline over our own sentences, NOT real-world accuracy.
